# ui.byronwade.com

> Meridian — cinematic design theme for AIs. Typed grammar. shadcn primitives. Not a custom component zoo.

Browsers hitting these URLs get designed HTML. Agents receive this raw text
(`Accept: text/markdown` / `text/plain`, or `?raw=1`).

## For agents

- [design.md](https://ui.byronwade.com/design.md): AI contract (frozen vs creative, OKLCH, contrast)
- [agents.md](https://ui.byronwade.com/agents.md): Strict operating manual — load order, Fluent 2 + Cursor mapping, skills, gates
- [architecture.md](https://ui.byronwade.com/architecture.md): System layers
- [llms.txt](https://ui.byronwade.com/llms.txt): This discovery map
- Theme grammar lives in-repo at lib/design/

## Research specs (ranked merge)

- [System index](https://ui.byronwade.com/system): All detailed specs
- [influences](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/influences/raw): Ranked inspirations + merge matrix
- [layout](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/layout/raw) · [ux](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/ux/raw) · [animations](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/animations/raw)
- [color](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/color/raw) · [typography](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/typography/raw) · [density](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/density/raw)
- [ai-surfaces](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/ai-surfaces/raw)
- Repo paths: `docs/influences.md`, `docs/layout.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/ux.md`, `docs/animations.md`, …

## Showcase

- [Theme](https://ui.byronwade.com/theme): Laws, knobs, closed roles, bans, contrast pairs
- [Surfaces](https://ui.byronwade.com/surfaces): Application · Marketing · Mobile · Desktop
- [Skills](https://ui.byronwade.com/skills): Top agent skills (skills.sh-ready under `skills/`)
- [Home](https://ui.byronwade.com/): Cinematic positioning

## Install skills

```bash
npx skills add byronwade/ui.byronwade.com
npx skills add byronwade/ui.byronwade.com --skill meridian-theme
```

## Enforce

- npm run check:design
- npm run check:contrast
- TypeScript unions in lib/design/grammar.ts
- Cinematic laws in lib/design/recipes.ts
